svg.title: Twelve RK3308 to DDR3L package placements
svg.desc: Each panel keeps the 355-ball Rockchip RK3308 fixed and moves the 96-ball Samsung DDR3L package to a different edge or offset. Orange pads mark the 49 DDR interface signals on each chip. Positions and RAM rotations come from the sample source. No routes are shown.
svg.text: Package placement preview · routes not shown
